name: Albert Sieg Orcian
original_name: アルベルト・ジーク・オルシアン
source:
The protagonist. Third son of the lord of the Orcian fiefdom. He is Tiana's fiancé.

A kind-hearted young man beloved by the people, though as a member of nobility, he is reputed to be somewhat undependable and lacking in leadership.

Seeing Tiana's reluctance, he works hard under the tutelage of Laurelia to become the "dependable, strong man" that Tiana idealizes, learning swordsmanship and how to treat women.

But there is another girl that Albert can not forget. A strong, earnest girl he met only once as a child whose face he can not remember anymore. The only thing he remembers is that - strangely enough - the girl was also named "Tiana."

[Translated from the [url=https://app.candysoft.jp/products/shibasoft/mamakanoEX/chara]official website[/url]]
